correctness.rationale: The precise ordered distinct-basis triple convention is used throughout. Finite-field Gauss identity gives the two triple forms (4),(5). The square parameter is surjective with q^2 fibers; nonsquare slope multiplication exchanges their quadratic classes. Averaging and trace-fiber quadratic characters give exact formula (1). Multiplicity sum is q^3 B_q, all 2p candidate phases are distinct for odd p, nonvanishing cases follow strict trace bounds. Hermitian 3x3 determinant gives (2), q=3 singular exactly 216 ordered/36 unordered, and q>=5 by Gershgorin. Every tested triple agrees numerically for p=3,5,7 and F9; tests corroborate unrestricted proof, do not establish it alone.

value.rationale: The phase-sensitive Bargmann triple invariant is a natural basic observable for MUB configurations, not determined by their pairwise unbiasedness. The result gives a closed count for every possible value over all q+1 bases, identifies the exact arithmetic phase-support jump between q=p and proper extensions, and determines the complete three-vector Gram spectral and q=3 linear-dependence census. The exact classification supports quantitative triple-column geometry and separates genuinely different arithmetic regimes; no unproved downstream theorem is claimed.
